latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video Open Source skill:

- Convert JPG, PNG, WEBP, and GIF images into 1080p MP4 video clips in under a minute.
- Automatic session creation and cloud GPU processing; no local setup required.
- Supports batch uploads, transitions, text overlays, audio tracks, and timeline previews.
- Files up to 200MB accepted; instant status updates and export/download options.
- Credits system with free starter tokens for anonymous users.
- Clear error handling and workflow guidance for common editing scenarios.
